original_metadata.name: 02 Unchanged Apply
original_metadata.notes: Recording after applying filters not setting updates

operator_clarification: The open Fantech app closed when recording started; operator reopened it and pressed Apply in the Fantech Windows app. Phone-page Apply filter is not the reported action.
analysis_method: Compare control-submit, endpoint zero OUT, URB length 8, raw setup-slot bytes starting 07 18. This is a VirtualBox-specific candidate data-stage view, not a reconstructed full payload stream.
limitations: UI attribution uses operator confirmation and time-separated bursts; no exact click timestamp was recorded.
VirtualBox stores these candidate data-stage bytes in setup slots, and many records are shortened. This is not a full USBPcap-equivalent capture.
The one-byte difference does not establish the meaning of that byte, persistent memory behavior, or a safe Linux write.
No command was replayed to the physical mouse.
Original metadata text is preserved unchanged; clarified action is stored in this derived analysis.

analysis_window.scope_note: Historical totals are full-capture counts. Setting-change comparisons use this time window and separate startup matching.

publication_note: Local VM names and host-assigned USB UUIDs are redacted; personal absolute paths are normalized. Capture hashes, packet evidence and findings are retained. Raw captures remain private.
